display_title: Regenerator Who Do Not Want to Be Strong

titles_en.title: Regenerator Who Do Not Want to Be Strong
The Regressor Doesn't Want to Get Strong

titles_native.title: 回帰者は強くなりたくない

description:
The thrill of fighting dangerous monsters, the exhilaration of clearing the highest difficulty dungeons!! 

My former self was intoxicated by his own power… but not anymore.

Ryouma was supposed to have died in battle, yet somehow he’s returned to the past. He has all the know-how and experience from his previous life. But if he can start over, peace is what matters most!

He chooses the non-combat class and deliberately picks the most generic player name possible: “Yamada Tarou” (essentially “John Smith”). 

He plans to live a relaxed, laid-back life, but somehow, he keeps getting stronger anyway!?
